messages:
Samir Patel: Hey team :wave: I’m Samir (started today on eng-infra). I requested access to Datadog/Grafana/Sentry via the self-serve but Grafana returns 403 and Datadog shows limited views. Anyone who can help unblock quickly?
Elena Gomez: welcome Samir! ping @ops-sre for Grafana SSO groups and @devex for any onboarding checklist gaps. Which email did you use?
Samir Patel: samir.patel@redwood.com
Mike O: Quick guess — looks like SSO group not assigned. ops-sre usually runs a group assign. If you want to try yourself the idp cli is `idp whoami && idp assign-group <email> infra-read` (you won't have perms tho).
Samir Patel: screenshot attached — shows "You don't have permission to view this dashboard (403)". tried incognito, cleared cookies.
devex-bot: Onboarding checklist reminder: Datadog (request via grants@redwood-infra.com), Grafana (SSO group infra-read), Sentry (team project invite). Links: https://idp.internal/requests, https://grafana.redwood.com, https://sentry.redwood.com
ops-sre: assigning now. `idp assign-group samir.patel@redwood.com infra-read` -> done. Added Datadog role dd-team-read.
Samir Patel: trying to login... I can view Grafana dashboards now, nice. Datadog shows full host/dashboards too. Thanks!
Samir Patel: Sentry still 403 on project pages though.
Elena Gomez: Sentry needs per-project membership. If you need org-wide read for cross-team debugging, we can get security to add project-access scaffold. Who's your team lead so we can request invites?
Samir Patel: team lead is Elena (that's you) — happy to be added to infra-projects.
Elena Gomez: I’ll request invite to projects: infra-core, infra-observability. @ops-sre if you can do a quick cross-project add that'd be great.
ops-sre: added Samir to infra-core and infra-observability projects in Sentry. Should reflect in a few minutes.
Samir Patel: confirmed, Sentry access good now. All set. Thanks everyone :tada:
Samir Patel: one last Q — where's the canonical observability onboarding doc? I found a couple old notes.
Elena Gomez: canonical doc: https://docs.redwood.com/devex/observability/onboarding-checklist — has exact steps and who-to-ping. Also check pinned messages in #devex.
Samir Patel: perfect. tagging this thread for future new-hires. :lock: :white_check_mark:
